title: Allow access to `PhysicsDirectSpaceState3D` from outside the main thread.
body:
### Tested versions

Godot 4.x
This issue is present when using a physics engine module such as GodotPhysics or the new JoltPhysics module.
This is not an issue when using Jolt physics as a GDExtension.

### System information

Windows 11

### Issue description

The following code prevents access to the PhysicsDirectSpaceState3D outside of the main thread, https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/15ff450680a40391aabbffde0a57ead2cd84db56/servers/physics_server_2d_wrap_mt.h#L107-L111

I wonder if this check is necessary as there is another check later that verifies that the space state is available,
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/15ff450680a40391aabbffde0a57ead2cd84db56/modules/jolt_physics/jolt_physics_server_3d.cpp#L231-L237

Removing the main thread check in a custom build allows my project to work with the integrated Jolt physics module just as it currently does with the GDExtension version. It seems GDExtensions bypass this main thread check.

### Steps to reproduce

Attempt a raycast from a Thread or from a node running on a sub thread group using an integrated physics module.

N/A
